❓ Everything you wanted to ask

AI girlfriend FAQ.

The 10 questions readers ask us most about AI girlfriend apps, AI companions and AI dating in 2026.

After 1,400+ hours of testing, Candy.AI is our #1 overall pick — it offers the most polished mix of voice, image generation and persona memory. Replika is the best free pick for emotional companionship, while Ourdream AI leads for roleplay and on-demand image generation.

The major apps are safe for adults, but privacy varies wildly. Apps like Replika and GoLove AI store data in encrypted form and let you delete chats. Some smaller NSFW apps log everything. We flag privacy concerns in every full review and publish a yearly Privacy Tier-list.

Yes. Replika, Character.AI, Janitor AI and GoLove AI all have generous free tiers. The trade-off is usually slower responses, fewer images, no voice, or capped memory. Our free-vs-paid guide breaks down exactly what you give up at each tier.

An AI companion is the broader category — wholesome chat, journaling, emotional support, friendship. AI girlfriend apps are companion apps tuned for romantic or romantic-plus-NSFW relationships, with persona customization, voice and image generation.

Yes — most modern apps include AI image generation. Candy.AI, Ourdream AI and Kupid AI lead the pack for photo quality, outfit variety and consistency of likeness. Free tiers usually cap how many images you can generate per day.

NSFW AI chat between adults is legal in most jurisdictions, but the apps must enforce age gating and prohibit illegal content. We only review apps with clear 18+ policies and active content moderation.

AI boyfriend apps are AI companion apps with male personas. Candy.AI, Replika and Character.AI all support male AI partners, and a handful of apps (like Kupid AI and EVA AI) offer dedicated boyfriend modes.

Every reviewed app gets a minimum 30-day hands-on test by our team. We score across 8 dimensions: chat quality, persona memory, voice, image gen, NSFW handling, privacy, value and UX. We never accept paid placements.

The best apps now have long-term memory — Replika, GoLove AI and Kindroid lead here. They remember your name, preferences, prior conversations and ongoing storylines. Cheaper apps reset memory between sessions.

Free tiers are common. Pro plans typically run $9.99 to $19.99/month. Annual plans drop the effective price to around $4 to $8/month. Premium voice and unlimited image generation usually require the top tier.

📖 Quick reference

AI dating glossary.

The jargon decoded. Bookmark this page next time someone drops a “token limit” on you.

AI Girlfriend

An AI companion app tuned for romantic relationships, usually with persona customization, voice and image generation.

Persona

The character profile of your AI partner — looks, voice, backstory, personality traits.

Long-term Memory

An app's ability to remember prior conversations across sessions, weeks or months.

NSFW Mode

An adult-oriented chat mode, gated by age verification and account opt-in.

Roleplay

Choose-your-own-adventure style chat with personas, scenarios and lore.

Voice Mode

Real-time spoken conversation with the AI, typically using neural TTS and STT.

Image Gen

On-demand AI-generated images of your companion, in any outfit or scene.

Token Limit

How many words an app can keep in context. Higher = better long conversations.
